title: Criminal
subtitle: 本課限定語境：criminal = a person who commits a crime · 「罪犯／犯罪者」
description: 本課限定語境：criminal = a person who commits a crime · 「罪犯／犯罪者」

words.note: 和 criminal 最實用、最常見的近義詞之一。
words.example: The offender was sentenced to three years in prison.

exercises.original: The criminal was sentenced to three years in prison after pleading guilty.
exercises.zh: 該罪犯認罪後被判監三年。
exercises.upgrade: The offender was sentenced to three years in prison.

options.explanation: pleading guilty + sentenced 顯示對方是已確認違法的人，offender 很自然。
suspect 只表示被懷疑，與已認罪、判刑的狀態不符。
在審訊期間可稱 defendant，但判刑語境更適合 offender。
如果已入獄可成為 inmate，但這描述拘禁身份，不是犯罪者身份本身。

exercises.original: The programme aims to reduce the number of criminals who commit another offence after release.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃旨在減少出獄後再次犯罪的罪犯人數。
exercises.upgrade: The programme aims to reduce the number of repeat offenders.

options.explanation: 再次犯罪的人自然稱 repeat offenders。
只是案件中的被告身份。
正在服刑不等於再次犯罪者。

exercises.original: Courts may treat a first-time criminal differently from someone with previous convictions.
exercises.zh: 法院可能會以不同方式處理初犯和有前科的人。
exercises.upgrade: Courts may treat a first-time offender differently.

options.explanation: first-time offender 是固定法律搭配。
偏某宗具體罪行的實施者，不常搭配 first-time。
形容詞，通常表示冒犯的。

words.note: 較日常、直接，表示違反法律的人。
words.example: The new system is designed to identify repeat lawbreakers.
words.exampleZh: 新制度旨在識別屢次違法者。

exercises.original: The campaign warns criminals that repeated violations will lead to heavier penalties.
exercises.zh: 宣傳活動警告違法者，重複違法會導致更重處罰。
exercises.upgrade: The campaign warns lawbreakers that repeated violations will lead to heavier penalties.

options.explanation: 強調「違反法律的人」，語氣直接。
offenders 也很接近，但本題 target 是更一般、更口語的 lawbreakers；加入 only 也使選項不自然。

exercises.original: Police said the new cameras would make it easier to identify criminals who ignore traffic laws.
exercises.zh: 警方表示新攝影機會更容易識別違反交通法規的人。
exercises.upgrade: Police said the cameras would make it easier to identify lawbreakers.

options.explanation: 交通違法者屬「違法者」，但不一定是重罪犯。
過度嚴重，交通違規通常不是 felony。
如果鏡頭已顯示違規行為，重點是 lawbreaking。

exercises.original: The article argues that ordinary citizens and criminals should be treated equally under the law.
exercises.zh: 文章主張一般公民和違法者在法律面前應被平等對待。
exercises.upgrade: The article argues that ordinary citizens and lawbreakers should be treated equally under the law.

options.explanation: 和 law 直接呼應，作一般化對比自然。
只是在訴訟程序中的人。

words.meaning: 作案者；加害者；犯罪實施者
words.note: 表示實際做出某宗犯罪或有害行為的人。
words.example: Police are still trying to identify the perpetrator.
words.exampleZh: 警方仍在設法確認作案者身份。

exercises.original: Police are still trying to identify the criminal who carried out the attack.
exercises.zh: 警方仍在設法確認實施襲擊的作案者。
exercises.upgrade: Police are still trying to identify the perpetrator of the attack.

options.explanation: carried out the attack 明確指某宗具體行為的實施者。
也可泛指犯罪者，但沒有 perpetrator 那麼聚焦這宗 attack。
警方可能有 suspect，但題句要表達實際犯案者。
只有進入訴訟程序才適合。

exercises.original: Investigators believe the criminal entered through a rear window.
exercises.zh: 調查人員相信作案者從後窗進入。
exercises.upgrade: Investigators believe the perpetrator entered through a rear window.

options.explanation: 案件敘述中很正式、自然。
也可接近，但較一般，且不如 perpetrator 正式精確。
只是被懷疑的人，未必是真正進入的人。

exercises.original: The criminal behind the fraud used several false identities.
exercises.zh: 這宗詐騙的作案者使用了多個假身份。
exercises.upgrade: The perpetrator of the fraud used several false identities.

options.explanation: of the fraud 是典型搭配。
除非已被定罪，否則不能假設。

words.meaning: 肇事者；罪魁；做錯事的人
words.note: 表示對某件壞事、錯事或犯罪負責的人。
words.exampleZh: 警方最終確認了作案者。

exercises.original: Police eventually identified the criminal responsible for the theft.
exercises.zh: 警方最終確認了對盜竊案負責的罪魁。
exercises.upgrade: Police eventually identified the culprit.

options.explanation: 表示「對這件壞事／罪行負責的人」。
表示罪責／可責性，是抽象名詞。

exercises.original: Everyone blamed the wrong person until the real criminal was found.
exercises.zh: 大家一直怪錯人，直到真正的肇事者被找到。
exercises.upgrade: Everyone blamed the wrong person until the real culprit was found.

options.explanation: the real culprit 是非常常見搭配，表示真正責任人。
也可能成立，但 real culprit 更自然地和 blamed the wrong person 對比。
形容詞，表示應受責備／有罪責。

exercises.original: The criminal was caught after fingerprints linked him to the scene.
exercises.zh: 指紋把他和現場連繫起來後，作案者被捕。
exercises.upgrade: The culprit was caught after fingerprints linked him to the scene.

options.explanation: 句子把此人當作真正犯案責任人。
如果證據只建立懷疑可用 suspect，但本句 criminal was caught 已把人視為犯案者。

words.note: 較正式、概括地表示做出不當或違法行為的人。
words.example: The law allows victims to seek compensation from wrongdoers.
words.exampleZh: 法律容許受害者向做出不法行為的人追討賠償。

exercises.original: The law allows victims to claim damages from the criminal or other person responsible for the harm.
exercises.zh: 法律容許受害者向做出不法行為的人追討損害賠償。
exercises.upgrade: The law allows victims to claim damages from the wrongdoer.

options.explanation: 民事／法律責任語境中可涵蓋不法行為者，不限刑事罪犯。
被告只是程序身份，案件結束後仍可談 wrongdoer。

exercises.original: The policy is intended to hold criminals and other wrong actors accountable.
exercises.zh: 政策旨在追究犯罪者及其他不法行為者的責任。
exercises.upgrade: The policy is intended to hold wrongdoers accountable.

options.explanation: 可涵蓋犯罪和其他不當行為者。
offenders 偏違法者，範圍可能較窄。
不能在未證實時直接等同責任人。

exercises.original: The company promised that any criminal involved in the fraud would face consequences.
exercises.zh: 公司表示任何參與詐騙的不法行為者都會承擔後果。
exercises.upgrade: The company promised that any wrongdoer involved in the fraud would face consequences.

options.explanation: 公司內部／法律責任語境中自然，而且不必預設具體刑事定罪。
被懷疑不等於應被追究。

words.note: 表示已由法院判定有罪的 offender。
words.example: The programme helps convicted offenders return to employment.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃協助已定罪的罪犯重返職場。

exercises.original: The programme helps criminals who have already been found guilty return to work.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃幫助已被判有罪的罪犯重返工作。
exercises.upgrade: The programme helps convicted offenders return to work.

options.explanation: already been found guilty 明確要求 convicted。
已定罪人士可能已獲釋，不一定仍是 inmates。

exercises.original: The law applies special reporting rules to certain criminals after conviction.
exercises.zh: 法律對某些已定罪罪犯施加特別申報規定。
exercises.upgrade: The law applies special reporting rules to certain convicted offenders.

options.explanation: 單獨可作形容詞／分詞，但這裡需要人物名詞片語。

exercises.original: Employers may have rules about hiring criminals with previous convictions.
exercises.zh: 僱主可能對聘用有前科的已定罪人士設有規定。
exercises.upgrade: Employers may have rules about hiring convicted offenders.

options.explanation: previous convictions 表示法律上已有定罪紀錄。
未說特定犯罪事件，而且 perpetrator 不必然已被定罪。
不適合把僅被懷疑者當作已定罪人士。
很多有前科人士並不在監獄。

words.meaning: 已判罪的人；囚犯（尤指已定罪者）
words.note: 傳統上指被法院判定有罪的人。
words.example: The novel follows the life of an escaped convict.
words.exampleZh: 小說講述一名逃犯的生活。

exercises.original: The story follows an escaped criminal who had been serving a prison sentence.
exercises.zh: 故事講述一名正在服刑後逃走的囚犯。
exercises.upgrade: The story follows an escaped convict.

options.explanation: serving a prison sentence + escaped 是典型 convict 語境。

exercises.original: The historical account describes how criminals were transported to penal colonies.
exercises.zh: 歷史記錄描述已定罪者如何被流放到流刑殖民地。
exercises.upgrade: The historical account describes how convicts were transported to penal colonies.

options.explanation: 歷史刑罰語境中是標準用法。
沒有被定罪的人不會因罪名被正式流放。
描述收容狀態，不是歷史法律身份的最佳詞。

exercises.original: The newspaper described him as a former criminal who had completed his sentence.
exercises.zh: 報章把他描述為一名已服刑完畢的前科人士。
exercises.upgrade: The newspaper described him as a former convict.

options.explanation: former convict 表示過去被定罪並服刑的人。

words.note: 在使用 felony 法律分類的司法制度中，表示犯重罪的人。
words.example: The law places restrictions on convicted felons.
words.exampleZh: 法律對已被判重罪的人設有限制。

exercises.original: In this jurisdiction, the law restricts firearm possession by criminals convicted of felonies.
exercises.zh: 在這個司法管轄區，法律限制已被判重罪者持有槍械。
exercises.upgrade: The law restricts firearm possession by convicted felons.

options.explanation: 題句明確說 convicted of felonies，因此是 felon。
未必所有在囚人士都是 felony convicts，而且有些 felons 已出獄。

exercises.original: The article distinguishes minor offenders from criminals convicted of serious felony-level crimes.
exercises.zh: 文章區分輕微違法者和被判重罪的人。
exercises.upgrade: The article distinguishes minor offenders from felons.

options.explanation: 只有在 felony 分類制度中才可這樣稱呼。

exercises.original: Not every criminal is legally classified as a felon.
exercises.zh: 並非每個罪犯在法律上都屬於重罪犯。
exercises.upgrade: Not every criminal is legally classified as a felon.

options.explanation: felon 是較窄的法律類別。
反而比 felon 更廣，不能表達「重罪分類」。
表示責任人，不表示罪行級別。
表示實施者，不表示 felony。
已定罪人士也可能只是較輕罪行。

words.note: 更完整、正式的描述性表達。
words.example: Investigators believe the perpetrator of the crime acted alone.
words.exampleZh: 調查人員相信該案作案人單獨行事。

exercises.original: Investigators believe the criminal acted alone.
exercises.zh: 調查人員相信該案犯罪實施者單獨行事。
exercises.upgrade: Investigators believe the perpetrator of the crime acted alone.

options.explanation: 正式、明確表示真正作案者。
只是被懷疑的人，不一定是真正作案者。
表示犯罪實施行為，不是人。

exercises.original: The criminal left no fingerprints at the scene.
exercises.zh: 作案者沒有在現場留下指紋。
exercises.upgrade: The perpetrator of the crime left no fingerprints at the scene.

options.explanation: 案件敘述中正式而精確。
alleged 表示尚未證實，語氣和原句把人視為實際作案者不同。

exercises.original: Police are trying to determine whether the criminal knew the victim.
exercises.zh: 警方正調查該案作案人是否認識受害者。
exercises.upgrade: Police are trying to determine whether the perpetrator of the crime knew the victim.

options.explanation: 重點是實際犯案者與受害者的關係。

words.meaning: 責任人；應為事件負責的人
words.note: 在上下文已經明確是犯罪時，可作較中性描述。
words.example: Police are searching for the person responsible for the robbery.
words.exampleZh: 警方正追查搶劫案的責任人。

exercises.original: Police are searching for the criminal responsible for the robbery.
exercises.zh: 警方正追查搶劫案的責任人。
exercises.upgrade: Police are searching for the person responsible for the robbery.

options.explanation: 上下文已明確是 robbery，因此可用較中性的描述性表達。
被懷疑者未必是真正責任人。
只有被正式起訴才適用。

exercises.original: The criminal who caused the damage has not yet been identified.
exercises.zh: 造成損害的責任人仍未被確認。
exercises.upgrade: The person responsible for the damage has not yet been identified.

options.explanation: 直接描述對結果負責的人，不額外加入法律程序身份。

exercises.original: Investigators want to establish exactly which criminal caused the loss.
exercises.zh: 調查人員希望確定究竟是誰應對損失負責。
exercises.upgrade: Investigators want to establish exactly which person was responsible for the loss.

options.explanation: 自然的描述性改寫，尤其適合尚在調查責任歸屬時。
如果已確定違法可用，但 establish exactly which 表示仍在確認責任人。
只能表示懷疑，不能等同最終責任人。
單獨是形容詞；需要 person responsible 或 was responsible 的完整結構。

falseSynonyms.zh: 疑犯 ≠ 已確定罪犯 suspect 是被懷疑可能犯罪的人。 前者未必有罪；後者表示其違法身份更確定。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The suspect was arrested. The offender was later convicted.

falseSynonyms.zh: 被告 ≠ 罪犯 defendant 是在法庭上被控告的一方。 刑事被告在定罪前仍不能單憑身份稱為 criminal。
囚犯 ≠ 所有罪犯 prisoner 指被拘禁的人。 有人可能被還押候審，尚未定罪。 同時，很多 criminal 也未必正在服刑。
在囚人士 ≠ 所有罪犯 inmate 是機構中的被收容者，常指監獄內人士。 它描述所在狀態，不等於犯罪身份本身。
被控者 ≠ 已證實犯罪者 the accused 指受到指控的人。 受到指控不等於已被判罪。
受害者 ≠ 犯罪者 角色相反。
詞形陷阱 - offence = 罪行／違規 - offender = 違法者 - offending = 冒犯的／違規的／造成問題的
詞性不同 - crime = 罪行 - criminal = 罪犯；犯罪的 - criminality = 犯罪性／犯罪行為
